propositions: A new advisory AGENT-tier CONTAINER criterion (decomp-shape) detects two decomposition-shape smells: layer-cake splits partitioned by architectural layer and consumed artifacts without ordering edges between producer and consumer siblings.

The decomp-shape criterion is registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), routed via criteria_routing.json with facet container and default_posture advisory, and added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA for fan-out through pass1_container.

The eval_solver container-arm is extended to run container criteria over fixtures carrying a children list, enabling bounded sanity testing of decomp-shape via rebar criteria eval without batch corpus.

Advisory posture prevents blocking; promotion to blocking is deferred until E6 order-stability (fleiss_kappa) clears the 0.6 floor and criterion effectiveness recorder signals high detection proxy and low false-positive proxy.

Bounded sanity testing commits hand-authored fixtures (layer-cake positive, consumed-artifact positive, vertical-slice negative, ordered-producer-consumer negative) with target recall 1.0 on positives and zero false-accept on negatives.
The criterion auto-flows into the standing effectiveness recorder with zero per-criterion wiring; promotion gate and E6 order-stability prerequisite are documented in plan-review-gate.md.
